compared.title: A short exact sequence of modules produces a long exact sequence of Ext groups
compared.statement:
\label{lemma-long-exact-seq-ext}
Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be an $R$-module.
Let $0 \to N' \to N \to N'' \to 0$ be a
short exact sequence. Then we get a long exact
sequence
$$
\begin{matrix}
0
\to \Hom_R(M, N')
\to \Hom_R(M, N)
\to \Hom_R(M, N'')
\\
\phantom{0\ }
\to \Ext^1_R(M, N')
\to \Ext^1_R(M, N)
\to \Ext^1_R(M, N'')
\to \ldots
\end{matrix}
$$
